name: 11672-sharegpt-7b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf (target; the ungated mirror of the gated meta-llama repo) + a locally converted yuhuili/EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B (EAGLE draft), num_speculative_tokens 2
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; the draft is pinned to draft-TP=1, which this engine requires -- it refuses to shard an EAGLE draft ('EAGLE does not support TP > 1 yet').
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, bounded at 500 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% by request count.
workload: REAL ShareGPT first-turn text, shipped with the item as configs/data/sharegpt-first-turn-318tok.parquet: 500 rows of 318 prompt tokens, 128 output tokens each. Columns `prompt` and `output_tokens_count`, read as a guidellm `parquet_file`; the backend turns that into max_tokens=128 with ignore_eos=True, and `request_format: plain` sends each prompt as written, with no chat template.
purpose: A 7B chat assistant with a draft model, answering four concurrent conversational prompts with short replies on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 899136b857d510f0e19b0e21ea32b49f8aa117ed (git describe:
# v0.6.6.post1-175-g899136b857d5). Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml (not portable).
# V0-engine item: VLLM_USE_V1 defaults to 0 at this vintage. Do not set it.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf

# A local conversion: `yuhuili/EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B` does not load as published at this vintage.
# Recipe in setupcard.md.
speculative-model: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B-vllm

num-speculative-tokens: 2

# Required at this vintage: the engine raises "EAGLE does not support TP > 1 yet". Explicit so
# that raising the target's TP later cannot silently take the draft with it.
speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size: 1

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Read off both checkpoints; pinned so a future default (bfloat16) cannot drift it.
dtype: float16

# 0.45, not the 0.9 of the posted serve command. 0.9 of an 80 GB card is 71 GiB, which does not
# fit whenever a neighbour process holds part of the GPU, and the engine then dies in CUDA-graph
# capture and is silently rebuilt once per request. The pool is oversized either way: four
# concurrent streams of 318+128 tokens hold 4 x 446 x 528 KiB = 0.9 GiB of KV (Llama-2-7B is MHA,
# 512 KiB/token, plus 16 KiB/token for the one-layer draft), against ~16 GiB left after ~15 GiB of
# weights and ~4 GiB of activation -- ~18x headroom, so no eviction or recompute is reachable at
# this load and the run behaves identically on an uncontended card.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.45

# V0 CPU swap space in GiB. 0 means a preempted sequence is recomputed rather than swapped.
swap-space: 0

enable-prefix-caching: false
